title: perf(mobile): pull request screens compile with the React Compiler
body:
The React Compiler skipped every pull request screen and hook. Most used `try`/`catch`/`finally` with a `throw` inside the `try`; neither shape compiles.

| Pattern | Files | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `try`/`catch`/`finally` around awaited work, `throw` inside | `usePullRequestAction`, `usePullRequestListActions`, `usePullRequestThreads`, `PullRequestMergeControls`, `PullRequestReviewersScreen` | the `try` body becomes an async function, and the handlers chain as `.catch()` and `.finally()` with the same behavior |
| `try` without `catch`, or `try`/`finally` | `PullRequestDiscussionScreen`, `PullRequestInlineCommentScreen`, `PullRequestReviewSheet`, `guide/useReviewGuide` | same |
| synchronous `try`/`catch` containing conditionals | `guide/PullRequestGuideScreen`, `guide/ReviewGuideExcerpt` | the body moved into a module helper (`diffFilesByPath`, `excerptPatch`) |
| logical expression as a computed object key | `usePullRequestListControls` | a small helper builds the controls map |
| manual memo deps the compiler couldn't preserve | `PullRequestRouteScreen` | manual memo removed |

Manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`/`memo` are removed from every file listed. `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`: 58 → 45.

**Verified on device** (Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, isolated server with real `gh` data):
- PR list: changed the state filter to Merged (saved, reloaded) and back to Open.
- PR detail (deep link and from the list): expanded the stack, switched to Activity, and opened a changed file's diff.
- The review sheet opens and accepts typing. I submitted nothing and merged nothing; the merge controls rendered but weren't pressed.
- No red box, and no `useMemoCache` or React errors in the Metro log.

**Renders while opening the PR detail screen** (`measure-renders --route`, median of 3, same base and device):

| Route | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| PR detail (`#21119`) | 10146 | 10048 |

About 1% fewer renders, which is within run-to-run spread (10122 to 10666 before). Call it no measurable change.

## Review follow-up

- Pull request actions, merge controls, reviewers, review guide and discussion branch on `AsyncResult.isFailure` instead of throwing a command failure into a `.catch`. Review sheet, list actions and "Ask about PR" (whose bodies throw validation errors) use `settlePromise`. Inline comment save uses `settlePromise` around the draft flush.
- Not exercised on device: the isolated server has no GitHub access.

Device: Pixel 9 API 36 emulator on nucbox-1, client rebuilt from `perf/mobile-compile-8` (the old one lacked the `T3FoldPosture` native view), Metro and an isolated seeded server on cups.

Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code.
